_how_to_sign: TO SIGN AN ENTRY, fill in all three of:
evidence      - what you are relying on, concretely. Not 'yes'.
attested_by   - your name. Both names, separated by '; ', for a joint statement.
attested_on   - the date, ISO format, e.g. 2026-09-22.
An entry counts ONLY when all three are non-empty. Leaving one blank is a
FAIL, which is the correct outcome for something nobody has checked. The
validator accepts a TYPED attestation - there is no signature-image or
cryptographic check - but that makes it easier to sign, not easier to fake.
Attest only to what you know, and only for yourself. A truthful FAIL is worth
more than a passed check that says something you cannot stand behind - the
whole point of the evidence rules in this repository.
REQ-008-T01 and REQ-009-T01 are JOINT statements by Krishna Annavaram and
Mahesh Rajendra. Both must sign their own block in docs/team/WORKLOG.md and
docs/team/TEAM_ATTESTATION.md before either entry is populated here. Ready-to-

They cannot be signed by the delivery team at all: the team is not the
evaluator, and the internal peer review is not the official review.
The entries marked unspecified_by_requirement cannot be signed at all: the
source document fixes no value to verify against, so the validator records
them as specification gaps and they stay FAIL by design.
